title: ALMA view of the Galactic super star cluster RCW 38 at 270 au resolution
question: To investigate the several 100 to 1000 AU-scale gas and dust structures, condensations, compact millimeter sources, and molecular outflows associated with massive star formation in the young Galactic super star cluster RCW 38.

data.arrays: 12-m array and ACA (7-m array and Total Power array) for Band 6; ACA (7-m array) for Band 7

what.value: VLT near-infrared images and Spitzer/IRAC archival images of RCW 38

evidence.loc: Discovery of two compact mm-sources: Source A and Source B
evidence.quote: The VLT/ISACC and NACO $J$, $H$, and $K_{\rm s}$ images obtained by (cite: wol2006) and (cite: der2009) indicate no significant excess of emission toward Source A and Source B.

Here, the Spitzer/IRAC 3.6, 4.5, 5.6, and 8.0 $\mu$m archival images (cite: wol2006) were used to estimate the upper-limit of the luminosity at 3.6–8.0 $\mu$m ($L_{3.6-8.0}$) for Source A and Source B

what.value: Position of H2 emission at 2.12 um from VLT/NACO

evidence.loc: High-velocity molecular outflows for Source A and Source B
evidence.quote: The triangle in Figure 6(a) depicts the position of the H$_2$ emission at 2.12 $\mu$m reported by (cite: der2009) using VLT/NACO, which is located near the tip of the blueshifted lobe

recipe.goal: Identify C18O condensations and derive their LTE and virial properties
recipe.method: Integrate C18O_all over -2 to +14 km/s, run clumpfind with lowest detection level of 5 sigma (3 Jy beam^-1 km s^-1), and calculate LTE column density, H2 mass, virial mass, and virial parameter.
key_parameters: velocity range = -2 to +14 km s^-1; lowest detection level = 5 sigma (3 Jy beam^-1 km s^-1)
assumptions: LTE; T_ex = 30-50 K from 13CO_all brightness temperature; [16O]/[18O] = 550; [H2]/[12CO] = 10^4; uniform density sphere without magnetic field or external pressure

recipe.goal: Perform continuum photometry and measure source sizes of Source A and Source B
recipe.method: Measure peak and integrated fluxes using aperture photometry on 233-GHz and 341-GHz_ACA maps (with local background subtraction in annulus for 341-GHz_ACA), and measure radii at half maximum using 1D Gaussian fits to horizontal and vertical profiles.
key_parameters: Aperture radii: 6''.5 (341-GHz_ACA, background annulus 6''.5 to 9''.8), 0''.5 (233-GHz), and 12'' diameter (233-GHz vs ACA flux comparison)

recipe.goal: Estimate H2 column densities, masses, and number densities of Source A and Source B from dust continuum
recipe.method: Calculate N_H2 and M_H2 from peak and integrated continuum fluxes at 341 GHz (ACA) and 233 GHz (12-m) using optically thin dust emission equations, and derive n_H2 assuming a spherical geometry.
key_parameters: kappa_341GHz = 1.8 cm^2 g^-1; kappa_233GHz = 0.899 cm^2 g^-1; R_g/d = 100
assumptions: Optically thin dust emission; D = 1.7 kpc; T_dust = 20-40 K for 341-GHz_ACA; T_dust = 100 K for 233-GHz; spherical geometry for n_H2

recipe.goal: Analyze small-scale C18O kinematics toward Source A
recipe.method: Create integrated intensity map over -2 to +4 km/s, first moment map, and position-velocity (p-v) diagram of high-resolution C18O data around Source A, and compare with Keplerian rotation and infall models.
key_parameters: velocity integration range = -2 to +4 km s^-1
assumptions: Tested Keplerian rotation or infall motion (v proportional to r^-1)

recipe.goal: Characterize high-velocity 12CO molecular outflows from Source A and Source B
recipe.method: Extract 12CO and C18O spectra to determine v_sys and wing velocities, map outflow lobes and velocity distributions |v_mom1 - v_sys|, and compute dynamical timescales, outflow masses, mass outflow rates, and mechanical force.
assumptions: Inclination angle i = 30-70 deg (0 deg for plane of sky); X_CO conversion factor provides a lower limit to M_lobe

recipe.goal: Estimate infrared upper-limit luminosities and compare with theoretical accretion luminosities
recipe.method: Measure standard deviation of flux density in 4'' area around Source A and Source B in Spitzer/IRAC 3.6, 4.5, 5.6, and 8.0 um bands to integrate L_3.6-8.0 upper limits, and compare with L_acc calculated from M_* and M_dot_acc.
key_parameters: 4'' area for standard deviation measurement; M_* = 0.1 and 1 M_sun
assumptions: M_dot_acc equals total M_dot_lobe of redshifted and blueshifted lobes; R_* scaling relation from Stahler et al. (1986) and Hosokawa & Omukai (2009)
